title: AI and the Future of Medicine
full_monologue: **AI is making doctors obsolete.** Imagine an AI diagnosing diseases faster than any human. It’s not science fiction—it’s happening now. Hospitals are using AI to analyze scans, predict outcomes, and even recommend treatments. But does that mean doctors will be replaced? Maybe not. Think of AI as a tool, not a replacement. It’s augmenting human expertise, not eliminating it. The real question is: how will we adapt? What will medicine look like in 10 years?
